news.title: BD Power Strikers Crowned National Champions of Bangladesh eFootball 2026!
news.excerpt: In a thrilling 4-2 climax against Dhaka Dragons eSports, BDPSC made history by lifting the prestigious National Championship trophy.
news.content:
In front of thousands of live stream viewers, BD Power Strikers Club delivered a masterclass in counter-attacking football to win the Bangladesh eFootball Championship 2026.

Captain Noyon scored three sensational goals, cementing his position as the nation's premier eFootball goalscorer with the Golden Boot award (14 tournament goals). Co-founder and playmaker Ashraful Ashem was instrumental in unlocking the Dragons' rigid defense with two world-class assists before securing the fourth goal in the dying minutes.

"This trophy belongs to every supporter and member of BDPSC who believed in our tactical discipline," said Noyon during the trophy ceremony. "We set a benchmark today, but our sights are now locked on the South Asia eFootball Masters."
news.author: BDPSC Media Team

news.title: Official Rating Engine Update v1.2 Released with Form Factor Calibration
news.excerpt: The BDPSC competitive analytics department has refined the Power Rating algorithm to accurately reward defensive contributions and clean sheets.
news.content:
BD Power Strikers Club has officially deployed Version 1.2 of its proprietary Rating & Ranking Engine. 

The update incorporates enhanced weighting for clean sheets, defensive clearances by defenders and goalkeepers, and adjusts the tournament tier multiplier for international matches. All rankings and historical snapshots have been transparently synchronized across the public portal.
news.author: Chief Statistics Officer

news.title: BDPSC Roars in South Asia Masters with 3-1 Triumph over Bengal Warriors
news.excerpt: Tanvir Ahmed scores two breathtaking direct free-kicks as BD Power Strikers claim top spot in Group A of the international circuit.
news.content: Opening their international campaign in style, BDPSC defeated Indian powerhouse Bengal Warriors 3-1. Tanvir Ahmed received Man of the Match honors after executing two unstoppable curling set-pieces from 28 yards.
news.author: Esports Correspondent
